description: This file manages the loading and registration of plugin registries within the OpenClaw project, including scope handling, plugin auto-enablement, and plugin loading logic.

methods.name: scopeRank
methods.description: Returns a numeric rank for the plugin registry scope to facilitate comparison.

methods.name: activeRegistrySatisfiesScope
methods.description: Checks if the active plugin registry satisfies the specified scope and expected plugin IDs.

methods.name: ensurePluginRegistryLoaded
methods.description: Ensures that the plugin registry is loaded according to the specified scope and configuration.
